name: Sovrium MCP Server
description: A team knowledge base served over MCP: documents an assistant reads and adds to with an API key.

BUILDPACK_URL.description: Sovrium buildpack — downloads the released, checksum-verified sovrium binary and boots the app config (Scalingo does not build Dockerfiles).

SOVRIUM_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Master key for encrypting stored credentials at rest (AES-256-GCM). Optional — the app generates and persists one on first start if unset. Keep it set here: the container filesystem is ephemeral, so a generated key would not survive a restart.

BASE_URL.description: Public URL of this app (e.g. https://my-mcp-server.osc-fr1.scalingo.io). Used for auth callbacks and absolute links.

AUTH_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Bootstrap the first admin account on first start (optional — you can also run `sovrium admin create <email>` later).

AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the bootstrap admin account (used with AUTH_ADMIN_EMAIL).

MCP_ENABLED.description: Switches the MCP endpoint on at /mcp — the whole point of this template.

MCP_TRANSPORT.description: How /mcp is served. streamable-http serves it over HTTP to a client anywhere; stdio switches the route off.
